name: Sine drift
description: Stacked sine warps fold a flat gradient into thick liquid-chrome contour bands. Slow-moving rather than quiet - the motion is calm but the image is not sparse.

folds.description: Number of warp passes. Each bends the field at i*i, so the last pass sets the finest detail - past about 6 it aliases before it reads as a fold.

warp.description: How far each pass displaces the field.

spread.description: How much of the palette the fold height covers.
